title: Elevator Requests III
summary: Each request gives an arrival time and floor. An elevator starts at a given floor at time zero and can move one floor per second or wait. A request is fulfilled when the elevator is on its floor at or after arrival, not by an earlier visit. Return the earliest time by which every request can be fulfilled.
officialConstraints: Floors1..10^9;1..16 requests; arrival times0..10^9; all requested and start floors valid.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
